newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SIDHU HALF CENTURY GIVES INDIA SOLID START.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SIDHU HALF CENTURY GIVES INDIA SOLID START.

text.p: India opener Navjot Sidhu continued his fine form on Saturday by blasting an unbeaten half-century in the opening session of the first test against Sri Lanka.
India were 75 for one at lunch with the tall Sikh unbeaten on 56 having hit seven fours and two sixes.

Sri Lanka's solitary success came with the wicket of Nayan Mongia, who was dismissed for seven by Ravindra Pushpakumara. The Indian wicketkeeper was caught at third slip by test debutant Mahela Jayawardena with the score on 36.
On a slow, bare pitch India captain Sachin Tendulkar opted to bat first on winning the toss.
Sidhu, who scored an unbeaten century in the three-day game against a Sri Lanka Board President's team on Thursday, struck off-spinner Muthiah Muralitharan for two sixes during his 93-ball innings.
Rahul Dravid joined Sidhu at the fall of Mongia's wicket and was unbeaten on 10 after an hour at the crease.
